text:
Amanda (PM): Quick sync — post-release follow-on planning. We got the Acme P1 crash report and a handful of small UX polish asks from onboarding flows. My proposal: ship the P1 fix in the next 2-week minor, include 1 low-effort UX polish that meaningfully reduces support volume, and push the remaining asks to the backlog. Need agreement on risk/estimates and rollout plan.

Raj (Eng): Can you paste the Acme repro steps? is it reliably triggered?

Amanda (PM): Steps from Acme: upload > metadata edit > click save. Repro ~60% on their dataset; they've attached logs.

Raj (Eng): OK I can reproduce locally. Root cause looks like a race on the metadata save handler. I can put a hotfix PR up today, but it needs e2e and a quick QA pass. Estimate ~1.5 dev days + 0.5 QA.

Taylor (Design): The onboarding polishes are mostly copy + spacing on the sample-data modal. Low effort — I can turn a patch into a PR in a couple hours. Would reduce user confusion a lot. :thumbsup:

Eva (SRE): Two questions: 1) does the fix touch any migration path or schema? 2) will it change request latency on the critical path? If not, we can do a canary rollout.

Raj (Eng): No migrations. Small change in save handler, no extra DB calls. Latency impact: negligible. Canary looks fine.

Sam (SRE): release-bot: starting canary pipeline for branch: fix/acme-metadata-race -> env: canary (10%).

release-bot: Canary pipeline started: build 2026.03.22-77. Health checks passed for 10% traffic after 12m.

Amanda (PM): Good. Proposal updated: ship Acme P1 fix + onboarding copy polish in next minor. Freeze for QA by Friday COB. Canary at 10% then 50% over 24h, full cutover if no errors > 4h. Rollback plan?

Eva (SRE): Rollback command stub: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api -n prod``` Also recommend keeping canary at 10% for at least 1 hour per region. Set alert on 5xx rate + latency 95th.

Raj (Eng): I'll queue the PR and tag @Taylor (Design) and @Sam (SRE) for verification. If QA passes tomorrow morning we can target Tuesday release window.

Taylor (Design): I’ll push the copy PR by EOD and add screenshots for QA.

Amanda (PM): OK we have tentative agreement. Action items: Raj create PR + link, Taylor PR for copy, Sam/ Eva configure canary alerts, QA verify by Fri. If any of the three blockers show up (security, schema, or persistent 5xx increase) we pull back. :eyes:

Raj (Eng): Sounds good. Filing ticket to convert remaining onboarding asks to quick backlog stories (label: post-minor).

Sam (SRE): Noted — will create the canary runbook and hand to oncall for the window.

Amanda (PM): Thanks all. I’ll send a short follow-up with the release checklist and owners.

Sam (SRE): release-bot: canary completed: promoted to 50% after 8h, no critical errors. Ready for broader rollout pending QA signoff.

Amanda (PM): Final call: we’ll ship tomorrow unless QA raises anything. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng): Agree.

Taylor (Design): :+1:

Eva (SRE): :ok_hand:
